digest.component_or_area: LLM capability system and provider integration
propositions: Two capability decisions use provider name string matching (startswith checks) instead of reading ModelProfile, causing silent feature loss for Bedrock-hosted Claude whose capability flags differ from direct Anthropic API
PR #121 patched the Bedrock capability loss with scattered force_prompted booleans across four call sites rather than a unified profile-reading approach
capabilities_for() must accept both model objects with .profile and lazy model strings, resolving the latter through pydantic_ai.profiles.* without requiring vendor SDKs to be importable
output_mode() and cache_settings_for() must dispatch on ModelCapabilities fields derived from ModelProfile instead of provider name strings, eliminating all string-matching decision branches
The rebar override table must force Claude (both direct Anthropic and Bedrock-hosted) to PromptedOutput despite native_structured_output=True in upstream profiles, per existing test contracts
Bedrock capability testing must work without boto3 present via field-stub layer, with a separate boto3-gated test pinning stubs against real BedrockProvider.model_profile() to prevent silent drift
